title: Migrate Layout App Camera Actions to View Kind
description: Apply the repo-wide camera-to-runtime-state sweep to the layout plugin (missed by an earlier multi-agent pass across puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity, architect, cad, fem 2d/3d, shooting, writer, sequence, mathematical, lowpoly). Layout has a dual blueprint/preview camera surface: find semio-s-app-layout-ui's setCamera action builder (currently ActionKind::Operation) and convert to the View-kind builder (.view_action) matching sibling apps. Find the handler emitting LayoutOperation::SetCamera{blueprint, camera} and change it to write to new ephemeral runtime field(s) on the existing Runtime struct instead (one per surface: blueprint camera + preview camera), emitting zero operations. Delete the LayoutOperation::SetCamera variant and all its match arms from semio-s-app-layout-op, plus any DSL/known-keys handling tied to it (being careful not to remove unrelated 'blueprint' key usage). Update wherever camera is read for rendering (both surfaces) to read runtime instead of the document. Rewrite the existing set_camera test(s) to assert zero operations and read the camera back from the rendered scene/runtime, following the raster/puzzle-2d pattern, and add a second test for whichever surface isn't already covered. Hand-fix any fixtures referencing the old field/operation. Run cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib for every touched crate (ui, op, dsl/pack/protocol/engine if they reference the removed items) and confirm pass.
summary:
Migrated the layout plugin's dual blueprint/preview camera surfaces from VCS-tracked document state + ActionKind::Operation to ephemeral runtime state + ActionKind::View, matching the repo-wide sweep already applied to raster/puzzle/cad/etc.

Entities crate (semio-s-app-layout, layout/⚡️implementation/🦀rust/📦lib.rs): removed `camera`/`preview_camera` fields from `LayoutDocument`; added `impl Default for LayoutCamera` (x=0, y=0, zoom=1.0) since `LayoutCamera` now only lives in ephemeral runtime state, never the document.

UI crate (semio-s-app-layout-ui): added two new fields to `LayoutPlayRuntime` — `camera: LayoutCamera` (blueprint surface) and `preview_camera: LayoutCamera` (preview surface), both `#[serde(default)]`, defaulted via `LayoutCamera::default()`. Moved the `setCamera` action builder from `.action_with(layout_internal_action("setCamera", ..., ActionKind::Operation))` to `ActionKind::View`, and relocated its registration line from the Operations group to the View group. Moved the `"setCamera"` handler arm from the `//#region 🔧Operations` region to `//#region 👁️View`; it now writes `self.runtime.camera` or `self.runtime.preview_camera` directly (chosen via the existing `surface_is_blueprint` check) and always returns `ActionEmit::default()` — zero operations, no `LayoutOperation::SetCamera` construction. `screen_to_world_for_surface` now takes `&LayoutPlayRuntime` instead of `&LayoutDocument` and reads the runtime camera fields (used by `hit_test_at`, `canvasDragOver`, `canvasDrop`). `render_blueprint`/`render_preview` now read `&runtime.camera`/`&runtime.preview_camera` instead of `&doc.camera`/`&doc.preview_camera` for the `Canvas2dScene` camera pose.

Op crate (semio-s-app-layout-op): deleted the `LayoutOperation::SetCamera { blueprint, camera }` variant entirely, its `apply_layout_operation`/`backwards_layout_operation` match arms, its `LayoutOperationDsl::SetCamera` DSL mirror variant, and both `layout_operation_to_dsl`/`layout_operation_from_dsl` match arms. Updated two doc comments that referenced camera as a coalesced/document operation.

Deleted test `set_camera_round_trips_per_surface`; removed the two `assert_op_line_round_trip(&LayoutOperation::SetCamera{...})` lines from `op_text_round_trips_every_layout_operation_variant`; rewrote `parse_op_reports_engine_parser_errors` to use `patch-frame ... patch=1,2,3` (verified the real kebab-case op-text keyword format via a throwaway debug test before writing this, since the old test's `setCamera` string was actually unrecognized camelCase that only vacuously passed) instead of the removed `setCamera` op line.

Protocol crate (semio-s-app-layout-protocol): rewrote both tests that used `LayoutOperation::SetCamera` as a stand-in payload (`op_binary_round_trips_and_agrees_with_text`, `document_text_round_trips_a_store_with_applied_operations`) to use `LayoutOperation::Pages(CollectionOperation::Patch{...})` operations instead.

Pack/DSL/engine crates (semio-s-app-layout-pack, -dsl, -engine): removed `camera`/`preview_camera` fields from every `LayoutDocument` struct-literal test fixture and dropped the now-unused `LayoutCamera` import; stripped the `"camera":{...},"previewCamera":{...},` JSON substring from all 9 raw-JSON test fixtures in the engine crate. Fixed `parse_dsl_reports_engine_parser_errors` in the dsl crate to assert on a non-numeric `grid` field instead of the removed `camera` block.

Fixture: hand-fixed `✏️s/🔌plugin/📏layout/📚example/📏sample.layout` — dropped its `camera { x=0 y=0 zoom=0.5 }` / `preview-camera { x=0 y=0 zoom=0.5 }` blocks (document no longer has these fields).

Tests: renamed/rewrote `set_camera_updates_surface_camera` (asserted 1 operation + read camera off `app.projection()`) into `set_camera_mutates_runtime_and_emits_no_operations` (blueprint surface — asserts `result.operations.is_empty()`, asserts the document is unchanged, and reads the camera back from the rendered blueprint scene's `cameraX`/`cameraY`/`zoom` JSON fields). Added a new second test, `set_camera_preview_surface_updates_independently_of_blueprint`, covering the preview surface (the surface the original test didn't exercise) and asserting the blueprint surface's camera stays at its default (0,0,zoom 1.0) independently.

Hand-fixed 4 pre-existing tests in the ui crate whose pointer-math assumed the old fixture's zoom=0.5 initial camera (`pointer_down_selects_frame_via_hit_test`, `pointer_move_updates_hover_highlight`, `registry_backed_pointer_move_is_view_only`, `canvas_drop_adds_frame_at_world_coords`) to use the new runtime default zoom=1.0 instead — `canvas_drop_adds_frame_at_world_coords` genuinely failed with the old zoom assumption (asserted exact world coordinates), the other three happened to still pass by coincidence (hit-test landed in the same frame either way) but were updated for consistency/correctness. Also stripped a stray `"camera"`/`"previewCamera"` pair from the `preflight_reports_all_expected_issue_codes` raw-JSON fixture.

Verification — cargo check --all-targets: clean across all 7 crates (semio-s-app-layout, -op, -ui, -protocol, -pack, -dsl, -engine), only pre-existing unrelated warnings (lifetime elision, unused qualifications, a pre-existing unused top-level `parse_layout_document` import for non-wasm lib builds that was not touched by this change). cargo test --lib per crate, all passing: semio-s-app-layout 1/1, semio-s-app-layout-op 9/9, semio-s-app-layout-ui 40/40, semio-s-app-layout-protocol 2/2, semio-s-app-layout-pack 3/3, semio-s-app-layout-dsl 4/4, semio-s-app-layout-engine 23/23 — 82/82 total, zero failures.

Repo-wide grep after all changes confirms zero remaining references to `LayoutOperation::SetCamera` or `layout::LayoutCamera`-as-document-field anywhere in the repo.

Not fully confident about: the exact "correct" default camera zoom (chose 1.0, matching the raster sibling app's convention, over the old fixture-specific 0.5) — this changed the effective initial framing of the layout app's canvas versus before, which is a user-visible (if minor) behavior change flagged here for visibility.
